values.kicker: Drive With Confidence, We've Got You Covered

values.intro: Why wait, talk to us about extended warranty for your truck with NTP National Truck Protection! We’re an authorized NTP service center in New Jersey with exceptional customer service. Kim in our finance department will explain the options for extended warranties for commercial trucks, trailers, and other vehicles. There are many options available to truck owners and it is important to compare the coverage offered and find the right protection for your truck. We offer a $250 inspection fee credit with the extended warranty purchase on Class 8 model truck year 2010 and newer. NTP is the leading truck warranty provider in the USA.
